themes.description: Users are experiencing payment transfer failures, lengthy KYC processes, and difficulty in closing their accounts.
themes.business_impact: High risk of customer churn due to delayed or failed payments, and lengthy KYC processes.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inconsistent and unreliable payment and KYC processes are causing frustration and mistrust among users.
themes.action_plan: • Review and optimize the payment processing system, implement more efficient KYC processes, and improve communication with users regarding account status and potential issues.

themes.description: Users are experiencing frequent issues with loading charts, resulting in a blank screen, incorrect data, or complete chart failure. This issue is affecting various features and devices, including iPhone and different chart types.
themes.business_impact: Failed chart loading can lead to loss of confidence in the app's accuracy and reliability, potentially driving customers away and impacting overall user engagement.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The possible root causes of this issue could be related to server-side problems, app configuration, or technical bugs within the charting system.
themes.action_plan:
• Fix chart loading problems and provide accurate data
• Enhance error handling and reporting
• Ensure smooth chart transitions and refreshments
• Review and optimize chart rendering code

themes.description: Users experience frequent bugs, crashes, and errors when using the app, including difficulty in saving charts, zooming issues, and app freezing.
themes.business_impact: Frequent crashes and bugs lead to frustrating user experiences, negatively impacting customer retention and driving users towards competitors.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Insufficient testing, outdated technology stack, or poor integration between components may be contributing factors.
themes.action_plan:
• Review and refactor the app's architecture, conduct thorough testing, and upgrade to the latest framework or libraries. Investigate and address underlying issues such as memory leaks and performance bottlenecks
• Work closely with the Android and iOS teams to identify and resolve specific platform-related issues
• Provide clear communication to users about known issues and upcoming fixes.
